data_quality_notes.market_size_variance: Market size figures vary across research firms due to different scope definitions (AI-driven PdM alone vs. overall predictive maintenance vs. AI in manufacturing). MarketsandMarkets AI-driven PdM ($2.61B in 2026) and Fortune Business Insights broader PdM market ($13.65B in 2025) are both credible; we use Fortune Business Insights as the primary reference for market size and MarketsandMarkets for CAGR of the AI-specific segment.
data_quality_notes.market_share_estimates: Company market share percentages (IBM ~20%, Siemens ~17%, GE Vernova ~14%, C3.ai ~8%, Augury ~5%) are approximate estimates based on MarketsandMarkets qualitative competitive positioning ('IBM and Siemens are leading players') and publicly reported revenue/funding data. Exact percentages are [unverified] — treat as directional.
data_quality_notes.roi_figures: ROI figures (30–50% downtime reduction, 8–14 month payback) are sourced from vendor-adjacent publications and case studies. Independent third-party validation is limited; actual results vary significantly by industry, equipment type, and implementation quality.
data_quality_notes.growth_3m: The growth_3m value of '+39% CAGR' reflects the MarketsandMarkets AI-driven PdM projected CAGR, used as a proxy for recent momentum. No quarterly PdM-specific revenue reporting exists to calculate a true 3-month growth rate [partially unverified].
